scope: Independent cross-review of three frozen CWP test migrations only; zero product-source/test edits by reviewer.

matrix.retired_oracle: Source body merely looking like a filesystem path is a physical-metadata leak.
matrix.contract: Source body is immutable quoted data; storage metadata remains pathless. Actual parser/version/coordinates/source membership must replay exactly.
matrix.new_tests: Two real PDFs preserve C-drive and file:// source text with actual unit.to_evidence_span; three retained negatives distinguish fabricated large/body paths (PARSER_INCOMPLETE) from metadata source_path (INPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID), always zero effects.
matrix.independent: Unseen file://operator-docs/reference-guide.txt traversed actual parse/select and replay summary; same real parser/coordinates with one changed body suffix was rejected. A genuine span with injected source_path was independently rejected.

matrix.retired_oracle: A quoted path in source claim text is automatically forbidden.
matrix.contract: A claim may quote selected source text; claim_id is identity metadata and may not expose a physical path. Source/evidence binding and role checks remain.
matrix.new_tests: Migration moves the path to claim_id and retains one-call failure/no response_bytes/no effects. Two positive source-path bodies survive selected result and final claim and validate_against(selected).
matrix.independent: Actual parsed selected material fed the public summary handler with ReplayModel; exact text survived and public validate_against passed. Existing claim_id path negative was executed separately and passed.

matrix.retired_oracle: Cumulative valid provenance crossing 64KiB must be refused.
matrix.contract: Complete JSON field evidence may grow; source-version/locator/value/JSON validity, atomic projection, idempotence and immutable raw remain authoritative.
matrix.new_tests: Both 40k details and merged patches are compared completely, projected fields checked, repeat unchanged with same assertions, raw unchanged, non-JSON evidence rejected.
matrix.independent: A different Unicode/English cumulative proof exceeding the old size bound was preserved exactly; repeat added no assertions. Empty locator, mismatched value, non-JSON detail and valid-shaped wrong source reference were refused without changing rows/raw.

runtime_observations.nonblocking_warning: Plugin autoload is disabled; existing pytest.ini asyncio_mode emits a configuration warning, with all selected assertions executed.

limits: Does not claim full Unit/CI, source H1 context closure, real summary/cache/RF adoption or whole PWF completion.
Reviewer does not self-review the separate FF hook-oracle delta; ROOT owns its independent acceptance/publication.
recommendation: Accept the three test-only migrations, preserve original RED/intermediate fixture-failure evidence, then publish via normal ROOT commit/push and inspect exact CI.
